description: This file contains a static internal class HexConverter that provides functionality to convert byte arrays to hexadecimal string representations. It includes a method ToString that converts a ReadOnlySpan<byte> to its hex string equivalent, optimized for short and long byte sequences.

classes.name: HexConverter
classes.description: A static internal class providing methods for hex string conversion of byte sequences.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts a ReadOnlySpan<byte> into a hexadecimal string representation, handling byte sequences of varying lengths with optimized buffer allocation.
